summary: This directory serves as the root for core application logic and presentation layers. It centralizes business rule enforcement, domain entity state management, and the adaptation of third-party UI libraries to ensure consistent component behavior and data integrity across the application.
responsibilities: Manage core business workflows and domain state transitions
Enforce business invariants and validation rules
Abstract and adapt third-party UI component libraries
Maintain consistent layout and visual structures for forms and data displays
Decouple application domain logic from infrastructure and UI implementation
relationships: The domain models provide the state that business logic and workflows operate upon.
UI adapters translate high-level application requirements into consistent representations using third-party components.
State transitions triggered by business logic are reflected through visual states managed within the UI adapters.
Validation rules ensure that domain entities maintain consistency during state transitions regardless of the underlying UI implementation.
designDecisions: Adoption of the adapter pattern to isolate the application from third-party framework changes
Domain-driven design to segregate business logic from UI concerns
Use of composition to build complex layouts and interactive forms from reusable primitives
Immutability in state management to ensure predictability across business and UI layers
Separation of validation logic from operational processing
